QUOTE: Defined: `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(m)` → `m`. The real field name is visible. / Not defined (default): `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(m)` → `private_m`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that code defining MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS sees plain member names while the default consumer of the public headers sees `private_`-renamed ones.
